workstream: C15 — OOD gating + temporal-invariant property/fuzz suite
environment: Linux (no Apple Vision pose extraction; ffmpeg/ffprobe available); canonical runs/ absent as expected

built.frame_analyzability: packages/vision-geometry/src/frameAnalyzability.ts — pose-free gate over decoded frame stats: single_frame_clip, duration_too_short (<500ms), duration_implausibly_long (>10min), still_image_video (mean |inter-frame diff| <= 0.5 on 64x36 grayscale), solid_color_frames (spatial luma std <= 2), letterbox_dominant (>40% near-black uniform rows). Reports notEvaluated for signals it cannot measure (camera motion, scene cuts, exposure flicker).
built.pre_analysis_gate: packages/analysis-pipeline/src/preAnalysisGate.ts (pre-analysis-gate-1) — combines FrameAnalyzabilityReport + pose-conditioned contract (no_person_found when pose sequence is empty; person_implausible_scale reusing evaluateCaptureQuality's player_too_small_in_frame / player_too_close_or_cropped). Typed abstention via existing Result/OperationFailure taxonomy: media failures -> corrupted_media, person/scale failures -> low_confidence. Null reports are recorded in notEvaluated, never treated as pass or fail.
built.frame_stats_extractor: packages/swing-lab/src/frameStats.ts — ffmpeg (scale=64:36, gray rawvideo) + ffprobe duration; feeds evaluateFrameAnalyzability.
built.invariant_checker: packages/swing-lab/src/invariants.ts — recursive artifact checker: negative_duration, contact_outside_event, phase_ordering_invalid, phase_spans_unordered, non_finite_confidence, confidence_out_of_unit_range, provenance_missing, predicted_declared_conflation, anchor_free_contact_conflation.
built.corpus_checker: packages/swing-lab/src/corpusCheck.ts — scans every .json under datasets/, reports parse failures + violations, never modifies artifacts. Script: pnpm -F @pickle/swing-lab invariants:corpus.

synthetic_negative_fixtures.note: SYNTHETIC NEGATIVES built locally with ffmpeg for OOD unit tests (packages/swing-lab/test/oodGate.test.ts); not real captures.

fuzz_suite.seeded_lcg: deterministic; every failure replayable from the seed
fuzz_suite.stroke_event_proposals: 300 seeds x (v1 + v2): endMs>=startMs, startMs<=peakMs<=endMs, finite confidence in [0,1], time-ordered events, artifact-invariant clean
fuzz_suite.temporal_phase_v2: 300 seeds: ordering, finite confidence, version present, anchor-free (anchorBasis=event_peak) must carry NaN contact (null in JSON) — never a fabricated numeric contact
fuzz_suite.frame_analyzability: 500 random FrameStats: total function, only registered reason codes, finite stats
fuzz_suite.seeded_violation_families: each invariant rule verified to fire on a seeded bad artifact

real_bug_found_by_fuzz.what: proposeStrokeEventsV2 paddle-peak refinement could move peakMs OUTSIDE the event span: paddle confirmation searches an [startMs-80, endMs+80] halo and assigned the raw paddle timestamp as refinedPeakMs.
real_bug_found_by_fuzz.repro: seed 31 of the stroke-event fuzz (LCG state seed*2654435761): v2 produced E1 startMs=6648, peakMs=8091, endMs=8088 (peak 3ms past end).
real_bug_found_by_fuzz.fix: clamp refinedPeakMs into [event.startMs, event.endMs] in packages/swing-lab/src/strokeEvents.ts and its byte-mirrored copy in packages/analysis-pipeline/src/sessionEngine.ts (mirror-guard test enforces identical sources). Boundaries and event identity unchanged; only the interior peak is clamped.
real_bug_found_by_fuzz.provenance: discovered 2026-08-29 by the new property test; reproduced standalone before fixing

checker_false_positives_fixed_during_dev: nested anchor-relative timing copies (TemporalPhaseBoundaries.relative) were demanded provenance they intentionally do not carry

human visual-annotation phases objects (devin-visual-v1/v2, coach-review/queue.json bundle.phases; 46 hits across 19 files) were demanded machine provenance (version/source) — their provenance lives on the enclosing annotation (schemaVersion/annotatorId). Checker now requires version/source only on machine-produced boundaries (identified by confidence/anchorBasis/relative fields).
corpus_check.honest_note: 0 violations is AFTER scoping the provenance rule to machine-produced boundaries; no dataset file was modified. Ordering / finiteness / conflation rules apply to all objects and found no violations.

honest_negatives_and_blocked: Pose-conditioned checks are contract-level only on Linux: no real pose sequences can be generated here (Apple Vision is macOS-only), so no_person_found / person_implausible_scale are exercised with constructed PoseSequence/CaptureQualityReport inputs, not real extractions.

The letterboxed title-card fixture also trips still_image_video (mean inter-frame diff 0.1407 < 0.5) because black letterbox rows dampen the downscaled diff; letterbox_dominant still fires independently.

The gate is exported from @pickle/analysis-pipeline but not yet wired into analyzeClip/analyzeCapture call sites — integration into the mobile capture flow is out of C15 scope and left to the integrator.

Thresholds (stillImageMaxDiff=0.5, solidColorMaxStd=2, letterboxMaxFraction=0.4) are set from the synthetic negatives plus one committed positive control (wm-volley-02); they are NOT calibrated against a real negative corpus.
Cascade impact of the peak-clamp fix cannot be measured here (pnpm lab:regen requires macOS pose runs); committed artifacts show no contact_outside_event violations, so no committed number changes.
